messages:
Marta Gómez: Quick convo: our late-enrich joins are driving cost spikes. Thinking about a compact-envelope mode for high-volume routes. Thoughts?
Noah Patel: Agreed. Compact mode should carry only tenant_id, billing_key, trace_id, route_hint, and a small provenance fingerprint.
Riley Zhang: How to preserve attribution for older clients? We need a mapping fallback for 48h at least.
Sanjay Rao: Proposal: attr-normalize stage before fanout. It computes billing_key cheaply: either read billing_key from compact envelope or map legacy attrs via an in-memory LRU. No DB sync on hot path.
Marta Gómez: Also add an envelope.sampled flag so sampled traces can keep full attrs. That preserves ad-hoc queries for traced samples.
Noah Patel: Pseudocode (very small):
```go
if e.Mode=="compact" { bk=e.BillingKey } else { bk=mapLegacy(e.Meta) }
emit(normalized{billing_key:bk})
```
Riley Zhang: Observability: emit 'compact_ratio', 'attribution_loss_rate', and 'sampled_full_rate'. Run in shadow mode first.
ingest-bot: Shadow run scheduled: feature/compact-envelope -> shadow starting 2025-04-01T00:00:00Z :gear:
Sanjay Rao: Rollout acceptance: attribution_loss_rate < 0.1% sustained, compact_ratio > 80% on targeted routes, no regressions on dashboard latency.
Marta Gómez: I'll draft a short RFC with test plan + rollback steps. Can @Noah and @Riley review?
Noah Patel: Happy to. I'll add perf microbenchmarks for the LRU lookup.
Riley Zhang: I'll prepare a small load test and shadow dashboards.
Marta Gómez: Thanks team — meeting to review RFC tomorrow 10am PT.
